text:
Claire (People Ops): quick ping  we're planning a compact handbook update next Wed 09:00 PT: "Work location & stipend". Highlights: adjusted stipend caps, a clarified desk vs stipend decision flow, and a 5-min compliance micro-cert for managers. Flag any blockers. :loudspeaker:

Hugo (Payroll): will this change pay runs? need CSV mapping and effective pay period.

Claire (People Ops): no mid-cycle retro. Changes apply to the first payroll after publish. we'll provide a CSV export including ack_version.

Priya (Legal): for EU/UK contractors we need a short addendum to avoid implying benefits. i'll draft language and VAT note by EOD.

Mateo (Comp): i'll post a country table tomorrow with tax flags (taxable vs non-taxable) and gross/net guidance.

Zoe (EMEA Ops): translations will take ~3 business days for short snippets. recommend publish master + "localized addendum coming" banner.

Claire (People Ops): agreed. manager checklist (6 bullets) + micro-cert required within 10 days. payroll CSV headers below — include `ack_version` so payroll can filter historical acks.

```
# stipend_export.csv
employee_id,full_name,email,region,employment_type,stipend_amount,paid_via,ack_version,ack_ts,manager_override,notes
```

Hugo (Payroll): OK please include `contractor_flag` too. i'll validate mapping by Friday.

Priya (Legal): added contractor pointer: "Contractors: see your contract or contact ops@redwood.com". legal sign-off pending final copy.

Mateo (Comp): noted — reimbursements still require receipts; stipends do not. adding FAQ blurb.

ack-bot: Managers will receive automated DMs on publish; nudges at day 3 and day 9. Use `/ack-bot export --since 2026-09-01 --format csv` to pull ack data. :white_check_mark:

Claire (People Ops): action recap: (1) publish master Wed 09:00 PT, (2) comp posts country table tomorrow, (3) legal posts EU addendum by EOD, (4) payroll validates CSV by Fri, (5) translations follow. any objections?

Zoe (EMEA Ops): no objections from EMEA.

Hugo (Payroll): will confirm Friday.

Claire (People Ops): thanks team 44f i'll share prod link + manager TL;DR after publish.
